_note: The Virgo Supercluster / Local Supercluster (WS-5b, RFC-039) — the ~33 Mpc supercluster our Local Group belongs to, dominated by the Virgo Cluster at its gravitational heart. A SCHEMATIC, NOT TO SCALE (PRD-030 principle 2): the Local Group sits at the origin as the 'you are here' anchor on the supercluster's outskirts, the Virgo Cluster is the dominant central concentration, and the surrounding clouds/groups are placed in a thin illustrative layout flattened toward the supergalactic plane (small z). Distances (dist_mpc) + classifications are real; the xyz layout is hand-authored for legibility, matching the local-sheet.json precedent.
_provenance: Distances + types: NASA/IPAC NED, Tully (1982) Local Supercluster clouds, Tully et al. Cosmicflows, Mould et al. Virgo distance. Schematic positions hand-authored for legibility. Science-reviewed 2026-08-08 (Virgo III→Virgo II Groups distance correction; Fornax + Eridanus dropped as Southern-Supercluster non-members; Canes Venatici Spur added; Ursa Major → 18.6 Mpc). Distance sources: `catalogue.dist_mpc` where a paper states the value (scripts/lib/structure-distance-catalogue.mjs, batch 06 review); a member with no entry is an anchor or its distance is unsourced.
